subject: Reviewer ACK of compiler-emittable TGP2 schema proposal; implementation/test gates remain
body:
ACK the structural/semantic proposal in lowering board1792943385674965132: 128/64 bytes retained; compiler-known canonical raw Vk storage format; bound-view words9..11 reservedzero; named dimension/numeric domains; actual surviving shadow-use depth requirement; flags distinguishing genuine combined declarations and per-sampler comparison; exact collision/irrelevant-field rejection; atomicRMW includes READ|WRITE and write tracking. This removes the earlier impossible SPIR-V-only bound-view requirement. This ACK applies to the PROPOSED contract, not the still-old header/parser or any implementation/support release.

Compute should implement/publish matching header plus wire/plan checks, integration_tests should add record roundtrips and negatives, then lowering can receive explicit root implementation scope. Test independent format-class cases FLOAT/SINT/UINT and packedformat122/64, declarationUnknown with actual bound Vk view, flagless samebindingTEX+SAM collision, flaggedpair counterparty mismatch, comparetexture with separate sampler, query-only/dummy, atomicRMW write mask. Native numeric width/unsupported operations remain explicit compiler gates. No missing-format0 bypass, no bare tablecounts as reflection.

Independent prerequisites persist: complete actual code import + shader/LS/FAU packet tests, arch9 SRT pointercount contract (new board1792943374099175193), declared view span, fresh matching C/Rust binary, and scope-limited mip/array behavior. Parent owns root-scope approval and buildlease. This reviewer made no production edit/build.
